description: Detailed conduction + switching loss model: TCR thyristor losses + reactor copper losses + TSC capacitor ESR losses, separated by operating mode (capacitive/inductive); voltage-dependent Q output.

unit.name: Generic 100 MVAR SVC (TCR+TSC), 132 kV
unit.source: Hingorani & Gyugyi (2000), Understanding FACTS. IEEE Press; Cigre TB 25 (1986), Static VAR Compensators; ABB SVC Application Guide (2018); IEEE Std 1031-2011.

Q_max_MVAR.note: Max capacitive output (TSC full, TCR off)

Q_min_MVAR.note: Max inductive output (TCR full, TSC off)

n_thyristors_series.note: Series thyristors per valve (approx for 132 kV)

reactor_R_ohm.note: TCR reactor copper resistance (total, both phases)
